title: RKLB Stock Keeps Flying Overnight: Analyst Says Rocket Lab Outbid ASTS, Other Rivals For Iridium In 'Bolt From The Blue' Deal
title_zh: RKLB 股票隔夜持续上涨：分析师表示，Rocket Lab 在“Bolt From The Blue”交易中的出价高于 ASTS 和其他铱星竞争对手
summary: CEO Peter Beck said Iridium gives the company its missing “third leg” in space applications, making it a “self-launching company.”
summary_zh: 首席执行官彼得·贝克表示，铱星为该公司在太空应用领域提供了缺失的“第三条腿”，使其成为一家“自我启动的公司”。

title: AMZN Stock Edges Up Overnight: Amazon Denies Anthropic Deal Restructuring Will Raise AI Costs
title_zh: AMZN 股价隔夜小幅上涨：亚马逊否认人为交易重组将提高人工智能成本
summary: Amazon is reportedly shifting from paying Anthropic based on computing hours to a token-based pricing model beginning next year, according to The Information.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，据报道，从明年开始，亚马逊将从根据计算时间向 Anthropic 支付费用转向基于代币的定价模式。

title: FuelCell Energy Stock Breaks Out Bullishly On Debt Financing Deal
title_zh: 燃料电池能源股因债务融资交易而看涨
summary: FuelCell Energy stock spiked Monday on government financing and a hefty PT hike after AI data-center deal. Bloom Energy jumped amid index transition.
summary_zh: 由于政府融资以及人工智能数据中心交易后利润大幅上涨，FuelCell Energy 股票周一飙升。布鲁姆能源公司 (Bloom Energy) 在指数转型期间上涨。

title: Did Salesforce Just Figure Out How to Beat the "SaaSpocalypse" With Its New Acquisition? Shares Are an Incredible Bargain If It Did.
title_zh: Salesforce 是否刚刚弄清楚如何通过其新收购来击败“SaaS 末日”？如果确实如此，股票将是一个令人难以置信的便宜货。
summary: Salesforce's new acquisition has figured out how to win in the age of agentic AI.
summary_zh: Salesforce 的新收购已经找到了如何在代理人工智能时代获胜的方法。
